phoenixcore.ponder.ebf.step1_overview: The Electric Blast Furnace smelts metals at extreme temperatures using heating coils.
phoenixcore.ponder.ebf.step2_controller: This is the controller block. Place it on the front-bottom of the structure.
phoenixcore.ponder.ebf.step3_coils: The two middle layers must be filled entirely with heating coil blocks.
phoenixcore.ponder.ebf.step4_cupronickel: Cupronickel coils provide the minimum temperature — enough for basic alloys.
phoenixcore.ponder.ebf.step5_kanthal: Kanthal coils raise the temperature cap, unlocking higher-tier recipes.
phoenixcore.ponder.ebf.step6_hatches: Place at least one Input Bus, Output Bus, Energy Hatch, and Muffler Hatch on the outer casing.
phoenixcore.ponder.ebf.title: Electric Blast Furnace
phoenixcore.ponder.freezer.step1_overvie: The Vacuum Freezer cools materials to extremely low temperatures.
phoenixcore.ponder.freezer.step2_hatches: Place your hatches on the outer casing — any face except the controller.
phoenixcore.ponder.freezer.title: Vacuum Freezer
phoenixcore.ponder.lcr.step1_overview: The Large Chemical Reactor processes chemical recipes with higher efficiency than its single-block counterpart.
phoenixcore.ponder.lcr.step2_pipe: The centre of the middle layer must be a PTFE pipe casing.
phoenixcore.ponder.lcr.step3_coil: Exactly one heating coil must be placed somewhere in the cross layer.
phoenixcore.ponder.lcr.step5_hatches: Hatches go on the outer casing faces. You need energy, item, and fluid IO.
phoenixcore.ponder.lcr.title: Large Chemical Reactor
